comparisonScope: 16 fixed training-source geometries in one procedural family. Supplied-body diagnostic is separate from predicted segmentation. Exact corners used only for scoring.
runtimeScope: Crop geometry only; excludes frozen MobileSAM and CNN inference, material classification, solver and exports.

notes: All 16 exact-body controls and all 32 frozen-SAM predictions reviewed against exact camera corners.
Projective side corners closely follow the true overlaps; original case 3 has a visibly displaced cap boundary (5.97% worst corner). Its occluded counterpart improves without any per-case adjustment.
One source clips an overlap corner; retained in all counts. No per-case exclusion.
Occluded cases retain small corner offsets; a good outline does not infer hidden material or certify a cutting pair.

findings: Replacing the affine construction with a projective outline fit removes much of the corner bias.
The visible-body mask can support a good fit behind these small notch occluders when the model uses the entire outline. No union with the coarse CNN is needed.
Colour-free outline acceptance can still accept an incorrect real object or unsupported decorative geometry; real-photo and independent export checks are required before adoption.
nextStep: Conditional projective fallback on all 42 fixed real-photo cases with unchanged material predictions, solver budget and independent editable checks.
